notes.title: Good News & Bad News
notes.notes: [p]The good news is that I've finally settled on an [b]exact release date![/b][/p][p]The bad news is that I've decided to postpone it again until [b]early next year.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This is my debut title, and unfortunately, I find myself miscalculating workloads. I simply haven't allowed enough time for polishing, final testing and opportunities for press to get their hands on early. That's why I canceled Steam Next Fest in October and chose a release date [b]right after the first Steam Next Fest in 2026.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Long story short...[/p][p][/p][h3][b]CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 [/b]will release on[b] March 4th 2026.[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p][b]I’d like to apologize[/b] not only for the delay, but also for my lack of communication. I am determined to release the best game possible and am working every spare minute to achieve that goal. As a solo developer, I am often overwhelmed by the sheer number of tasks that need to be done in addition to the actual development of the game (such as being active on social media and keeping you updated). [/p][p][/p][p]I sincerely hope you will bear with me a little longer, and I can't wait to present [b]CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134[/b] to you on [b]March 4, 2026[/b], in a state that it deserves.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for your patience![/b] [/p][p]Have a nice day![/p]

notes.title: Decision to Postpone Release
notes.notes:
[h3]Today I made the decision with a heavy heart to postpone the planned release to October 2025.[/h3]

As the initially planned release date approached fast, I felt the pressure rising to ship [b]CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134[/b] in a state I would consider finished, but not reflecting the true potential I see in it.

While the content of the game should be ready around the time I initially planned to release, there is still more I can do to [b]improve and polish[/b] in significant ways.

Thanks to your awesome feedback in the several past months I really found out in what direction I should push the game and some [b]features got added[/b] to the previously already far advanced project. I want to give you the best game CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 can be. And that unfortunately takes me longer than I anticipated.

I want to apologize for not keeping the schedule and I hope you stick with me a few more months until I will release the absolute best version of the game in [b]October 2025[/b].

[h3]I'll try to keep you informed about the game’s state at all times.[/h3]
I also just started a devlog video series on the FiendGames YouTube channel, where you can follow the development and get some exclusive insights into the process of creating CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134. 
[b]
Take care and see you soon![/b]
Gabriel Mittermair
Fiend Games

notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
The [b]Demo[/b] is finally here! Get a [b]30-minute insight into the gameplay, story and atmosphere of CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134[/b] and play comfortably on PC, SteamDeck, or for full immersion in VR.

Dive into the beginnings of the main game and learn about your inevitable fate. Explore the first rooms, solve small puzzles and try to reactivate the power. Find out more about the former staff of this now (almost) abandoned Soviet bunker.

At the end of the demo you will find a link to a feedback form. [b]Your help can significantly influence the further development of the game![/b]

Feel free to share your thoughts on the current state of development in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2816730]Community Hub[/url]!

notes.title: Demo Available in 3 Days
notes.notes:
In 3 days, the [b]demo[/b] and with it a first look at [b]CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134[/b] will be ready to take you into the beginnings of this horror-survival adventure.

Whether it's in the comfort of your PC, on SteamDeck, or in VR for full immersion - it's entirely up to you how you try to escape the iron prison deep underground!

Mark [b]September 27th[/b] in red on your calendar and be among the first to sneak through the ([i]almost[/i]) abandoned rooms of an old Soviet bunker!

[b]Stay thrilled![/b]
